hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for binary prediction market (YES/NO outcome) pools implementing a VALS dynamic fee formula (e^[λ*(Δx/L)*σ]-1). Every swap requires a backend-signed sigma parameter; fees are captured from the collateral token and distributed to share holders via a YieldDistributor. Also tracks LP virtual balances and feeds pool prices back to the prediction market.
